_comment: Source-of-truth for the PokeAByte mapper address export.
Each entry under 'lookups' becomes a key in patch_versions.json's per-version address table.
An entry can be one of:
{ "symbol": "foo" }                — resolves to the address of the C symbol
{ "symbol": "foo", "offset": 16 }  — symbol address plus a fixed offset
{ "address": "0x210200C" }         — raw absolute address (escape hatch; defeats auto-tracking)
Offsets may be int or hex string (e.g. "0x214").

_comment_global_pointer_var: sApplication.currOverlay -- the OverlayManager* field at offset 4 of
the static Application struct in src/main.c. The mapper dereferences
this to obtain the heap-allocated 'base_ptr' used for all party/battle
_comment_stp_vars: stpVars -- the StpVars struct in src/_stp.c that holds STP
forced-encounter flags, etc.). The mapper exposes this as
variables.stpVars; XML properties reference it via {stpVars}.
This address shifts per patch, so it must be exported per-version.

base_offsets._comment: Constants used by the mapper preprocessor relative to *base_ptr or *sSaveDataPtr. Bump per patch if the in-RAM layout shifts.
